figures.label: Figure 8
figures.title: 40Ar/39Ar ages distribution of Orgnac samples.
figures.caption: 40Ar/39Ar ages distribution of Orgnac samples. The 40Ar/39Ar Orgnac ages are quoted at 2σ level with an age distribution (n=40/47) reported by a probability density distribution using Isoplot [21] (7 open circles are rejected). The weighted mean of 302.9 ± 2.5 ka (2σ, n=40/47, MSDW=1.2, P=0.16).
